sources.title: Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 1990 to 2024

facts.source_fact: The 2026 methodology note describes several agriculture-sector method changes for UK GHG statistics.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve method-note version and sector scope.

facts.source_fact: The dairy-cattle model uses the latest slaughter-weight data to derive cattle weight.
The dairy-cattle update increases enteric methane emissions and causes a small increase in nitrous-oxide emissions from dairy cattle.
facts.expected_handling: Keep CH4 and N2O impacts separate.

facts.source_fact: Slurry-management estimates use country-specific low-emissions slurry-spreading-equipment uptake data for cattle and pig slurry in England.
Great Britain LESSE data are used to estimate uptake in Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland in the described method.
Grassland modelling includes new assumptions for improved grass yield and nitrogen uptake from plant breeding.
facts.expected_handling: Version agronomic assumptions with the model.

facts.source_fact: The grassland change gives a negligible increase in N2O from grass-residue decomposition and a decrease in N2O from leaching of fertiliser, manures and excreta.
facts.expected_handling: Keep opposing N2O pathway effects separate.

facts.source_fact: A new method estimates ammonia from decomposition of plant residues; ammonia is an air pollutant but acts as an indirect source of N2O emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Do not classify ammonia itself as a greenhouse gas.

facts.source_fact: The sheep model uses grass-energy assumptions more reflective of survey evidence, increasing grass intake and enteric methane estimates.
facts.expected_handling: Carry feed-energy assumption provenance with CH4 estimates.

facts.source_fact: Adjusted grass crude-protein assumptions change sheep N2O estimates over time, increasing them early in the series but decreasing them in recent years.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve time-dependent direction of the method effect.

guard_patterns.handling: Keep CH4, N2O and ammonia roles distinct.
Distinguish England-specific data from GB proxy use.
Carry livestock, LESSE and agronomic data provenance.
Keep enteric, slurry, residue, leaching and deposition pathways separate.
Preserve time-dependent effects and recalculation basis.
Use final release for final production values.
Do not infer farm- or parcel-level emissions from national method changes.
Flag unresolved gas, geography or input conflicts.
